Description: Unique ID the app gives each company.
Registered legal name of the company.
Name used in trade, if different.
National company register number (CVR in Denmark).
VAT or tax ID.
Country where the company is legally established.
Allowed values: UK, DE, FR, ES, IT, DK, NL, other

Description: Registered office address.
Parent company ID if part of a group.
Person the app and regulators contact.
Email of the main contact.
Phone of the main contact.
Countries the company reports in.
Allowed values: UK, DE, FR, ES, IT, DK, NL

Description: Turnover from the latest annual accounts.
Currency of the turnover figure.
Total packaging handled in the previous calendar year.
UK pEPR size from turnover and tonnage.
Rule / validation: Large if > £2m and > 50 t; Small if > £1m and > 25 t

Description: Country this registration covers.
Allowed values: UK, DE, FR, ES, IT, DK, NL

Description: Company's role for its products in this market.
Number in the national producer register.
Scheme or PRO used in this market.
EPR representative where the company is not established in the market.
Rule / validation: Required if market != country of establishment

Description: How often reports are due in this market.
Whether German thresholds are exceeded.
Rule / validation: Yes if above 80 t glass, 50 t paper/board or 30 t other

Description: Named person who approves submissions in this market.
Product code every packaging record links to.
Name of the product as sold.
Brand name.
Barcode of the sales unit.
Rule / validation: Digits only, valid length and check digit

Description: Liquid volume of the sales unit; decides deposit scheme scope.
Whether the main pack is designed for reuse.
Reference to the record showing the pack is as light and small as it can be.
Empty space in grouped, transport or e-commerce packs.
EU Declaration of Conformity number.
Version of the DoC.
Rule / validation: Not blank if DoC reference given

Description: Test reports, certificates and assessments behind the DoC.
Rule / validation: At least one for EU markets

Description: Whether the EU material label is on pack.
Link the pack's QR code points to.
French sorting logo and instructions.
Rule / validation: Yes for household packs sold in FR

Description: Italian material codes and disposal advice.
Whether the container is in the market's deposit return scheme.
Rule / validation: Not blank for cans and plastic bottles

Description: Unique ID of the packaging component.
SKU this component belongs to.
What the component is.
Primary, secondary or transit.
Sales units sharing this component (1 for primary).
Main material.
Allowed values: Glass, Aluminium, Steel, Paper/board, Plastic, Wood, Fibre composite, Other

Description: Plastic type, for plastic components.
Allowed values: PET, HDPE, PP, LDPE, PS, PVC, Other

Description: Share of each material by weight, for composites.
Weight of one empty component.
How the weight was obtained.
Colour and transparency.
Anything that could disrupt recycling.
Result of the recyclability assessment.
Allowed values: UK: Red, Amber, Green; PPWR: A–E

Description: Share of recycled material.
Certificate backing the recycled content claim.
Whether the component touches the drink.
Supplier declaration against the PFAS limits.
Lead + cadmium + mercury + hexavalent chromium.
Supplier screening for substances of concern.
Contribution band for plastic components.
Plastic weight × (1 − recycled share).
Supplier of the component.
SKU sold.
Country the units were supplied in.
Period the units belong to.
Household (retail) or non-household (on-trade, business).
Sales units supplied in the period.
Units shipped out of the market.
England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.
Country the packed product was imported from.
